description: This Java source file defines the `ProtocolAdapterProperties` class, which encapsulates configuration properties for protocol adapters in the Hono framework. It includes various configurable parameters such as authentication requirements, vendor properties inclusion, default value usage, event loop check timeout, maximum connections, and tenant idle timeout.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class that manages configuration properties for protocol adapters in Hono.

methods.name: isAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Returns whether device authentication is required for the protocol adapter.

methods.name: setAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the protocol adapter should always require device authentication.

methods.name: isJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if vendor properties are included in downstream messages.

methods.name: setJmsVendorPropsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables inclusion of vendor properties in downstream messages.

methods.name: isDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if default device values are used to augment messages.

methods.name: setDefaultsEnabled
methods.description: Configures whether to use default device values to augment messages.

methods.name: getEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Gets the timeout in milliseconds for the vert.x event loop liveness check.

methods.name: setEventLoopBlockedCheckTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for the vert.x event loop liveness check.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of concurrent connections accepted by the protocol adapter.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections for the protocol adapter.

methods.name: isConnectionLimitConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a connection limit has been explicitly configured.

methods.name: getTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Gets the duration after which a tenant times out when inactive.

methods.name: setTenantIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the duration after which an inactive tenant times out.
